evidence.reason: The after version removes the return statement, so the function now returns undefined instead of a number, which conflicts with the test assertion subscriptionCharge(40) > 0.

The after version removes the metering.initialize() call and changes evaluate arguments from (units, 0.1, "monthly") to (units, 0, "benchmark"), altering the metering behavior relied upon by callers and tests.

The after version swaps priorities from [multiplier, multiplier/2] to [multiplier/2, multiplier], changing the numeric result of usageCharge, which is exercised by the test usageQuote(30, 0.1, "monthly").amount > 0.

The dependency path shows subscriptionCharge value-references chargeUnit, which value-references usageCharge, so the two edits are coupled and the right edit's numeric change can affect the left edit's behavior.

result.userExplanation: 这两处修改分别移除了 subscriptionCharge 的返回语句并改变了 usageCharge 的优先级顺序，可能导致订阅计费返回 undefined 且数值结果与测试预期不符。
result.suggestedAction: 请恢复 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge 中的 return 语句并保留 metering.initialize() 调用，同时确认 src/metering.ts#usageCharge 中 priorities 的顺序是否应保持为 [multiplier, multiplier/2]。
